title: Implement Legacy Banking System Integration Layer
problem_statement: Platform lacks integration adapters for legacy VB6 banking application and OCX components, preventing effective modernization of existing banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Cannot modernize existing banking application without breaking customer-facing operations and losing transaction history
suggested_approach: Create dedicated legacy integration agent with VB6 form parsing, OCX component mapping, and database migration capabilities

provenance.evidence: No legacy system integration artifacts found

title: Implement Banking-Grade Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: Current platform lacks banking-specific authentication controls, session management, and regulatory compliance for customer authentication
risk_if_unaddressed: Cannot deploy to production banking environment without proper customer authentication and regulatory compliance
suggested_approach: Enhance security engineer agent with banking-specific auth patterns, implement OAuth2/OIDC integration, add audit logging

provenance.evidence: Security agent exists but banking-specific controls not evident

title: Replace File-Based Storage with Banking-Grade Database
problem_statement: Current JSON file-based tenant memory storage lacks ACID properties, scalability, and audit capabilities required for banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption, loss of transaction integrity, inability to meet banking regulatory requirements for data persistence
suggested_approach: Implement PostgreSQL or similar ACID-compliant database with proper transaction management, encryption at rest, and audit logging

title: Reduce Analyst Agent Complexity
problem_statement: Analyst agent has 25 imports indicating potential over-coupling and violation of single responsibility principle
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult maintenance, testing challenges, increased bug risk, reduced code reusability
suggested_approach: Split analyst agent into specialized sub-agents (code analyzer, dependency analyzer, risk assessor) with clear interfaces

title: Implement Banking Domain Model and Business Rules
problem_statement: Platform lacks banking-specific domain models for accounts, transactions, customers, and business rules for interest calculation, withdrawal limits, etc.
risk_if_unaddressed: Cannot accurately modernize banking operations without proper domain modeling and business rule enforcement
suggested_approach: Create banking domain agent with account models, transaction processing, interest calculation, and regulatory compliance rules
